    "Everything needed for multi-collaboration projects is in one place."

  "cons": [
    "Real-time project progress can be difficult to monitor.",
    "The main page becomes challenging to navigate with many ongoing projects.",
    "The platform lacks some advanced features for complex research projects."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Clinical Research Coordinator likely found Basecamp generally easy to use for managing and tracking tasks, appreciating its centralized approach to project collaboration. However, the simplicity of Basecamp might have led to frustrations with tracking real-time progress or navigating multiple projects, potentially hinting at a need for more advanced features given their role in research."
